"Man Down" is a song by Barbadian singer Rihanna from her fifth studio album, Loud (2010).
Rihanna, fellow Bajan singer Shontelle, and production duo R.
City wrote the song with its main producer, Sham "Sak Pase".
Loud is the fifth studio album by the Barbadian singer Rihanna.
It was released on November 12, 2010, by Def Jam Recordings and SRP Records.
The album was recorded between February and August 2010, during the singer's Last Girl on Earth tour (2010–2011) and the filming of her first feature film Battleship (2012).
